About Booking Holdings Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world’s leading provider of online travel and related services, provided to consumers and local partners in more than 220 countries and territories through five primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. For more information, visit BookingHoldings.com and follow us on X BookingHoldings. About Booking Holdings Romania: Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania, opened in September 2021. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leveraging industry best practices, and fostering collaboration opportunities across Booking Holdings’ brands and business units. Booking Holdings Romania is supporting Booking Holdings and its portfolio of brands by providing capabilities in many important areas like Security & Fraud, Application Development, Data Analytics, Data Governance, IT End-User Support, Global Business Services, Marketing, Procurement, Legal & Compliance, Privacy, as well as Program Management Office, with new competences in other areas being added throughout the coming years.
Booking Holdings Romania is a Center of Excellence based in Bucharest, Romania and was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of our Brands.As part of our Booking Holdings Romania team, you will have the opportunity to be a part of the worlds leading provider of online travel, with a mission of making it easier for everyone to experience the world through five-primary consumer facing brands: Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable. Role description We are part of the IT Services department and our main focus is on the tools used by our colleagues from Booking.com along with the colleagues from the other brands of Booking Holdings. Some examples of the products we develop and maintain are: Booking Benefit ,a system which allows our colleagues to have discounts on our platform; Unified Voice Portal, a tool which allows Voice Engineers and IT Support colleagues to provision users into the VoIP systems and to troubleshoot VoIP-related issues; Meeting Rooms Suite, a system which allows meeting rooms management across our offices, Ninja, a tool helping IT Support colleagues to provide the best services to all our colleagues. Here is the technology stack and some of the tools used by the team: Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Kubernetes, TypeScript, React, Git, Gitlab (MRs, CI/CD), Harness.io (deployment), Grafana, Jira, and more. This role provides a hybrid way of working with an onsite presence of 2 days/week.
